units.source_text: 苗子那间破陋得像棚子似的家，至今依然在杉村里荒废着。

en.t: Naeko's shabby little house, as crude as a shed, still stood abandoned in Sugimura even now.

units.source_text: 因为一个单身少女是无法待下去的。

en.t: That was because a young girl living alone could not have gone on staying there.

units.source_text: 长期以来，由一对在杉山劳动的中年夫妇和他们上小学的女儿住着。

en.t: For a long time, a middle-aged couple who worked in the cedar hills had lived there with their daughter, who was in elementary school.

units.source_text: 当然也没有收他们称得上房租的钱，况且这也不像是能收房租的房子。

en.t: Of course, they had not been charged anything that could really be called rent, and besides, it was hardly the kind of house one could charge rent for.
